name: Celestial Lantern Reef
description: An underwater reef where glowing lanterns replace coral, casting soft light through crystal-clear water.
prompt: A vibrant underwater scene: a reef made of countless luminous lanterns in shades of amber, teal, and rose, each lantern shaped like traditional paper lanterns but glowing from within. Schools of iridescent fish swim among them. Sunlight filters down from the surface, creating caustic patterns. Hyper-detailed, 8K, cinematic lighting, wide-angle view.
caption: Dive into a sea of light where lanterns bloom like coral. ✨🌊 #CelestialLanternReef
